project_metadata.job_title: Lead Clipper to Lead a Clipper team
project_metadata.job_description:
We're Building a Clipper Army — Join The Teyron Machine (Long-Term | Performance-Based)
The Teyron Machine is the personal brand of Teyron — founder of Biofit and Overfloww Mentorship. We are building a fully systemized, high-volume short-form content engine targeting 100K Instagram followers and 100K YouTube subscribers.
We are now recruiting skilled video clippers to join a structured, growing team. This is not a one-off gig. We are building something long-term — and the right people will grow with it.

The Opportunity

$2.00 CPM (per 1,000 views)
$600 maximum payout per clip
Weekly + monthly performance bonuses
Total budget: $10,000

Your income scales directly with your results. The better your clips perform, the more you earn.

How It Works
Everything runs through a structured system. Views are tracked. Performance is measured. Payouts are calculated transparently based on real numbers — no guesswork.
You will be assigned a dedicated account. Your clips go up on that account. Your earnings are tied to how those clips perform.

The Trial Process

Selected candidates will be given access to content from our Instagram and YouTube
You produce 3 clips from that content
We review quality, style, and brand alignment
If approved — you get assigned an account and start posting
Once you're posting, you start earning

Simple. No hoops. Just show us what you can do.

Room to Grow
We are building a team with leadership built in. Top performers will have the opportunity to step into a Lead Clipper role — onboarding new clippers, guiding the team, and taking on greater responsibility within the system. If you want to lead, there is a clear path to do that here.

Who We're Looking For

Experience clipping long-form content into high-retention short-form (Reels, Shorts, TikTok)
Clean, manual editing — no AI subtitles, no AI editing tools
Consistent, reliable, and able to hit volume targets weekly
Someone who wants to be part of a system — not just pick up a job and disappear
Long-term mindset only


To Apply
Submit the following:

Portfolio or samples of your clip work
Tools and editing software you use
Your weekly capacity (how many clips can you deliver per week)
A brief note on why you want to be part of a long-term team

We are not looking for the most experienced person. We are looking for the most committed one.
